review_basis: DEC Appendix D p. 184 draws the prefiling Subject Property as the developing part of old lot 37 plus all lot 155. Recorded development agreement pp. 4 and 9 defines developer land 38/39/155 and reserves ancillary project uses on 155; egress agreement p. 3 places the exact jobs on 38 and 39 and identifies retained 37 only as an easement parcel. Later areas total 24880. Retained floor 69357 plus development floor 14579 exactly reconciles the 19v1 old-lot floor 83936.
